clustering.molecular: Hill-canonical formula string, exact-match clusters; no-commit=NC
clustering.crystalline: normalized space-group token, exact-match clusters; no-commit=NC
clustering.property_ef: order-invariant single-linkage on eV/atom at tol 0.15; no-commit=NC

entropy: normalized Shannon entropy over clusters, H/log(n_samples) in [0,1]

threshold.rule: flag if entropy >= threshold; dev-optimal pooled F1

note: Detection-only: returns no reference value to inject, so it can detect but not repair.
